crossRefs.note: For the perverse is an abomination to Yahweh, but his friendship is with the upright.

crossRefs.note: The fear of Yahweh is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.
crossRefs.keyword: He that hath a froward heart. Heb. The froward of heart

crossRefs.note: With the pure, you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.
crossRefs.keyword: He that hath a froward heart. Heb. The froward of heart

crossRefs.note: One winking with the eye causes sorrow, but a chattering fool will fall.
Wise men lay up knowledge, but the mouth of the foolish is near ruin.
The mouth of the righteous produces wisdom, but the perverse tongue will be cut off.
A fool’s lips come into strife, and his mouth invites beatings.
A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are a snare to his soul.
The words of a wise man’s mouth are gracious; but a fool is swallowed by his own lips.

translations.web: One who has a perverse heart doesn’t find prosperity, and one who has a deceitful tongue falls into trouble.
translations.bsb: The one with a perverse heart finds no good, and he whose tongue is deceitful falls into trouble.
translations.kjv: He that hath a froward heart findeth no good: and he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief.
translations.asv: He that hath a wayward heart findeth no good; And he that hath a perverse tongue falleth into mischief.
